Description

Boxed Acid is a structure available for purchase at the Goblin Town Shop costing $4,480. Once placed on your property, it appears as a lime-green cube that can be resized to dimensions of up to 15x15 studs.

On a property Boxed Acid behaves identically to other Acid found throughout the game. Boxed Acid is similar to Boxed Lava as it also inflicts harm upon the player.
